# FixFusion

> FixFusion (FixFusion LLC) is a licensed general contractor based in Noblesville, Indiana, serving Hamilton County and central Indiana since 2014. It handles residential and commercial new construction, renovation and remodeling.

The whole site is a single page: https://www.fixfusionbuild.com/

## Services

- New construction
- Renovations
- Remodeling
- Restoration
- Interior finishing
- Exterior finishing
- Custom home design
- Architecture
- Project consulting

## Service area

Noblesville, Carmel, Fishers, Westfield, Indianapolis, Zionsville, Greenwood, Fortville, Avon, Geist, Plainfield, Lawrence, Anderson and the rest of Hamilton County and central Indiana.
